label: Bible Study
prompt: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am _____.
verse: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
note: Mountain-moving faith without love adds up to exactly nothing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will _____ my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
verse: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
note: After Israel's shepherds failed, God says He'll do it Himself: I will feed my flock.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he had an _____ of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
verse: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
note: Goliath's gear: a brass helmet and a coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels — he dressed for a much longer fight.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For I was _____ to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verse: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
note: Ezra had bragged to the king about God's protection, so he was too embarrassed to ask for a military escort.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always _____ with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verse: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
note: Before the flood, God set a limit: 'My spirit shall not always strive with man' — his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
